GOAL: 个股板块事实 StockPlateAssignment 与等价比对(设计见 /home/exedev/fw/DESIGN-plate.md 第 2/3/5 层)。依赖 C054 的 plate_rules。
SPEC:
 1. build_stock_plate_assignments(*, trade_date, static_primary_by_symbol, static_themes_by_symbol, pool_rows=(), reasons_by_symbol=None, hot_plate_names=()) -> PlateAssignments(assignments: Mapping[symbol, StockPlateAssignment], notes, content_hash)。组合顺序与旧系统一致: 对池内个股: build_yest_limit_theme_candidates(pool_plate, reason_candidates, existing_themes) → choose_runtime_primary_plate(...) → order_runtime_theme_candidates; 池外个股: 用静态 primary/themes 原样经 rules 清洗; reasons_by_symbol[symbol] 为原因行列表(每项含 reason/group_str/gnsm)。
 2. StockPlateAssignment 字段: symbol, trade_date, primary_plate(None 表示缺失, 不写"其他"), themes(tuple), sources(tuple, 取 static|pool|reason), rule_version, flags(tuple: generic_primary, primary_not_in_themes, themes_missing, pool_plate_missing), status(READY|PARTIAL|MISSING), content_hash。池 plate 为 "其他"/空 => flags 含 pool_plate_missing 且不作为板块候选。
 3. 比对脚本: --legacy-snapshot JSON(格式同 validation/real-hot-plates-20261013/plate_mapping_*.json: {"stock_plate":{sym:plate},"s2p":{sym:[...]}}), 可选 --pool JSON(封存池 artifact data.rows) 与 --reasons JSON({sym: reason_text}); 输出: n_compared, primary_equal, themes_equal, 差异按类别计数(primary_diff_generic / primary_diff_alias / themes_order_only / themes_content / missing_in_core / missing_in_legacy) 与最多 20 条样例。缺失不当 0。
TESTS(<=8 个): 池内个股的候选合并与排序、池外原样清洗、池板块"其他"不入候选、primary 缺失不补、flags 取值、status 取值、比对类别计数。
ACCEPT: 全量测试通过(同 C054 命令); diff 仅 SCOPE_WRITE。
